description:
With cl-ppcre vendored (#1597), no consumer needs Quicklisp.  Remove the step
everywhere and leave only the FALLBACK mention.

=== DONE (s481a) ===

Removed: tools/install-matrix/deps.sh's Quicklisp bootstrap + ql:quickload
block (a stock image's Lisp side is now `sbcl --version`);
.github/workflows/ci.yml's "Install Quicklisp + cl-ppcre" step, replaced by one
that prints the SBCL version and says in the log why there is nothing else;
tools/t/install-container.t's /etc/sbclrc, which existed ONLY to load Quicklisp
-- its #1327 note is kept and re-pointed (a core memoising the BUILDER's
asdf:*user-cache* is still a PCL bug, and with the init file gone legs (c)/(d)
are what shows nothing re-enters ASDF at startup at all).  The Containerfile's
text is part of the image key, so the base image rebuilt rather than reusing a
stale one -- 38 s, where it used to spend minutes on Quicklisp.

`sbcl --script` was PROBED and now works (it reports the vendored directory), so
the README's sentence about --script skipping ~/.sbclrc is FALSE and was deleted
rather than rewritten.

BAR: `grep -rn -i quicklisp README.md docs/caching.md docs/pcl-commands.md
tools/ .github/` lists only the fallback ("if the vendored copy is absent, ASDF's
ordinary search -- distro package, Quicklisp, a ~/.sbclrc") and the notes saying
the step is gone.  prove tools/t/install-container.t 17/17 PASS.
subject: P1(b): remove the Quicklisp step from deps.sh, ci.yml, install-container.t's image and the README -- nothing installs a Lisp library any more
